sourceReview.method: 核验上传 PDF 指纹，渲染完整第 17 页并视觉对照原文。

validation.liveAssetIntegrity: all offline-manifest files and SW match tested dist byte-for-byte
validation.interaction: two consecutive new units submitted with one wrong and one correct selection; question and options translated only after submission; full translation last; 2 vocabulary entries per question; next/previous and reload preserve history
validation.offline: browser-simulated offline restores new question and submitted explanation; general local suite also stops HTTP server and reloads cached app

limits: 390px Edge 视口不是实体手机；模拟离线不是关闭 Windows 网卡。

题目内容保持预先编写，不调用运行时 AI API；James 引述不当作实验，69% 不解释成健康改善的因果比例。
